purpose: Apply actual recursion bounds, not a version-only advisory suppression.
changes: Parse admits at most 100 combined brace/paren nesting levels. Escaped, quoted and bracket-class literals do not count.
compile/expand/stringify reject caller-created AST traversal deeper than 100 container levels.
expand parent-queue traversals reject chains/cycles longer than 100 links.
maxLength is read once; NaN cannot disable the original 10,000-character hard cap.
compatibility: Original grammar/output is preserved within bounds; excessive nesting now throws an intentional SyntaxError/RangeError. No configurable depth bypass.
limits: Does not bound total expansion cardinality or arbitrary AST width.
Does not sandbox hostile getters or executable objects.
Local fork requires explicit maintenance until a reviewed upstream replacement exists.

validation.cssByteEquivalence: Three current application CSS files and one variant fixture
